note: Focused sensitivity checks for the independent ITU-T V.90 Table 13 oracle in t_v90jd.cpp. The first mutation is a deliberate transmit-side standards repair: Table 13 has 22 rate capabilities and reserves wire bits 41:46, while the blob and reconstruction emit those six positions from the parameter mask. The second changes the accessor's observed internal behaviour; it is not called a standards repair because Table 13 says receivers do not interpret reserved bits and downstream processing only consults bits 0..21. The remaining mutations exercise the independently derived framing, field directions and V.34 Figure 14 CRC rather than differential equality.
